BD still needs to collect concrete examples of affected customer follow-up workflows. Keep this action open until someone confirms completion.

The infrastructure vendor proposed maintenance for next month. Engineering must review customer impact and the rollout plan before anything is confirmed. No outage date or change approval has been agreed.

- Which onboarding steps still need partner validation?

The figures show platform usage, not revenue. Higher weekly active users do not prove that sales increased or that any specific partner campaign caused the growth. No revenue impact has been measured.

Previous action
BD still needs to collect concrete examples of affected customer follow-up workflows. Keep this action open until someone confirms completion.
